lines: UP column, third from the bottom, and I have written it in ink.
Twelve years I have kept this roll and I still like doing that bit.
Name in the DOWN column, please. No, I do not need it now.
I write both columns myself when you come back up.
Everybody comes back up. Some of them take a week over it.
You did it in a day.
I have been sitting on this bench for four days.
...Right. Right. Fine. Move over, I am going down.
I went down on Tuesday. I got two stones onto two plates
and then I put the third one somewhere extremely stupid.
So I am sitting here until I stop being angry about it.
Cage takes two. Hands inside, and do not lean on the gate.
Sixty fathom, and it is the same sixty fathom whether you look down it or not,
so my advice is do not look down it.
